connector.name: Shingou
connector.registryDescription: Hourly crypto news sentiment and typed market events, with sources on every signal.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.shingou.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package shingou-mcp-stdio. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.shingou, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
